messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick sync  wet got a two-track ask from LangChain: marketplace packaging + an SI-friendly deployment guide for Gateways/Orchestrators. Need a concrete checklist for both.

Liam (Product): Two tracks make sense. Marketplace track = listing metadata, pricing tier guidance, legal/cert blurb, and verified performance badge. SI track = network diagrams, auth patterns, and a hardened config for on-prem.

Ravi (Eng Integrations): From eng: include a compatibility matrix for supported connector versions (LangChain v0.1x / LlamaIndex v0.8x), and a small perf table for 2/8/16 token windows. Also list recommended quantization for inference on 8-bit GPUs.

Clara (DevEx): I'll author a sample manifest for marketplace assets (icons, screenshots, quickstart link) + a terraform snippet for provisioning a minimal Dedicated environment.

Tess (Solutions Eng): SI guide should have a deployment checklist: certs (mTLS), OIDC mapping, VPC peering steps, and monitoring hooks (Prometheus + tracing). Also sample playbook for a live partner PoC.

infra-bot: Created ticket PART-4201 assigned to Ravi and Clara

Maya (Partnerships): Good. Let's define the preflight smoke tests we require for partner demos (keep them runnable in CI):
- auth handshake (API key + OIDC)
- basic generate call (sync)
- streaming call smoke
- embedding vector consistency test
- fallback routing scenario (simulate model OOM)

Ravi (Eng Integrations): I'll add a minimal test script. Example (run with REDWOOD_API_KEY):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-2-mini","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}] }'
```

Liam (Product): For the marketplace listing we should lock a performance badge policy: if 95th latency < 250ms on small model under our standard harness -> "Verified" badge. Who owns the validation run?

Clara (DevEx): DevEx can run a one-off validation harness for partner submissions. We'll publish the harness and expected outputs. Need partner consent for us to run smoke tests on their deployment.

Tess (Solutions Eng): On SI side, partners will want an installable helm chart and an "air-gapped" instructions doc. Also a troubleshooting checklist for common firewall/NAT issues.

Maya (Partnerships): Also coordinate with hardware partners (NVIDIA / Cloud GPU teams) to get recommended instance SKUs for our quantized runtimes. Ravi, can you capture those SKUs in the infra reqs?

Ravi (Eng Integrations): Yup. I'll list T4/A10x/GPU SKU recommendations and memory baselines per model size in the integration template.

Sam (Legal): Small note: marketplace listings need a short privacy/security blurb and export compliance checkbox. I'll draft a template clause.

Maya (Partnerships): Timeline proposal: doc drafts by Fri, internal review Mon, partner preview Wed, validation run next Mon. Announcement window aimed for the following quarter.

Clara (DevEx): I'll create the quickstart repo skeleton and add a GH Action that runs the smoke tests against a partner-provided endpoint. ETA EOD Thu.

Liam (Product): Add an FAQ section for "what breaks" items: context window limits, streaming resumption behavior, and KV cache TTL expectations. Make that prominent in the SI guide.

Tess (Solutions Eng): For joint demos: propose a canonical demo flow (LLM prompt -> gateway chains tools -> orchestrator breakpoint -> observable traces). We'll document a script and timeline so partners can rehearse.

Maya (Partnerships): Assignments: Clara = marketplace assets + quickstart repo; Ravi = test harness + infra reqs; Tess = SI guide + demo script; Liam = badge policy + rollout plan; Sam = legal templates; Maya = partner comms & announcement cadence.

Ravi (Eng Integrations): One more technical ask: include a minimal repro for error injection to test fallback routing. I'll add a pytest that simulates OOM/latency to verify retry to smaller model.

infra-bot: Created subtask PART-4201.1 (harness infra) assigned to Clara

Maya (Partnerships): Perfect. I'll loop in LangChain and a reference SI (ScalePartner) and schedule a 30 min tech review next Wed. Please drop any pre-reads in the repo under /docs/onboarding before EOD Tue. :calendar: 

Clara (DevEx): Will do. I'll also add a short "what we expect from partners" one-page PDF for marketplaces and SI installs.

Liam (Product): Thanks team. Small follow-up: should we require partners to include a sample dataset for the demo to avoid flaky results? Suggest yes.

Tess (Solutions Eng): Agreed. We'll require a seed dataset + deterministic prompts for the verification harness.

Maya (Partnerships): Awesome. Posting meeting notes and task list to PART-4201. Closing the sync. :white_check_mark:
